user_intent: Choose the easiest feasible common terminal grip that withstands the other hand turning the upper layer. Keep terminal center/height/tilt reproducible after the needed whole-cube reorientations.
preferred_first_hypothesis: Reuse the successful placement and reorientation where possible, then compare minimal regrasp changes. Palm support, index support, and a position between fingers remain alternatives rather than prescribed locations.
selection_priority: Upper layer can sweep through a quarter turn without hitting any right-hand part
Lower-body grip withstands actual layer-turn load after integration
Continuous transitions from the required whole-cube reorientations return to a reproducible terminal pose
Among passing candidates, minimize extra joint changes, regrasp time, and manual placement sensitivity
comparison_scope: 4 starting-center hypotheses x9 gain/friction cases; same open hand and finite actuators. Not a comparison of complete grasp trajectories or lifting between fingertips.
remaining: Find a lower-body contact arrangement that clears the whole upper-layer sweep
Check a continuous free-cube transition to the same terminal pose after each needed reorientation
Verify actual left-hand layer-turn load after integration
